heading.ht: Konnen moun ki vle reprezante w.
heading.en: Meet the people seeking your vote.

intro.ht: Chèche yon non. Chwazi yon eleksyon. Louvri foto yon moun pou eksplore sous enfòmasyon ki konsène li.
intro.en: Search a name. Choose a race. Open a portrait to explore the sources about that person.

search.ht: Chèche yon non, yon pati oswa yon lokalite
search.en: Search a name, party or place

status_note.ht: Done sa yo preliminè; yo pa konfime KEP valide kandidati a.
status_note.en: These data are preliminary and do not establish a validated candidacy.

snapshot.ht: Done piblik KEP yo te verifye nan dat

no_results.ht: Pa gen rezilta pou filtè sa yo. Eseye yon lòt non oswa efase filtè yo.
no_results.en: No registrations match these filters. Try another name or clear the filters.

load_error.ht: Nou pa rive chaje lis la. Eseye ankò oswa sèvi ak lis pa pòs yo anba a.
load_error.en: We could not load the directory. Retry or use the office lists below.

browse_note.ht: Lis sa yo mache menm san JavaScript.
browse_note.en: These lists work even without JavaScript.

web_hint.ht: Chwazi yon sijè ki gen sous pou eksplore enfòmasyon yo.
web_hint.en: Choose a topic with sources to explore the information.

web_label.ht: Twal sous enfòmasyon sou moun sa a
web_label.en: Web of sources about this person

no_sources.ht: Nou poko ajoute sous revize nan kategori sa a.
no_sources.en: No reviewed sources have been added to this category yet.

coverage.ht: Achiv sa a ap grandi. Li pa gen tout sa ki te janm pibliye sou moun nan. Kantite sous yo montre travay rechèch nou, li pa yon nòt sou moun nan.
coverage.en: This archive is growing. It does not contain everything ever published about this person. Source counts describe our research, not a score for the person.

preview_empty.ht: Chwazi yon fil pou dekouvri sous yo.
preview_empty.en: Choose a strand to discover the sources.

preview_hint.ht: Louvri yon sous pou wè non piblikatè li, dat li ak rezime li. Ou ka fèmen apèsi a pou retounen sou twal la.
preview_hint.en: Open a source to see its publisher, date and summary. Close its preview to return to the web.

no_autoplay.ht: Videyo a ap chaje sèlman lè ou chwazi gade li.
no_autoplay.en: The video loads only when you choose to watch it.

registry_summary.ht: Non sa a parèt nan done piblik enskripsyon KEP pou eleksyon 2026–2027 yo. Done sa yo preliminè; yo pa konfime KEP valide kandidati a.
registry_summary.en: This name appears in the CEP's public registration data for the 2026–2027 elections. These data are preliminary and do not establish a validated candidacy.

native_record.ht: Enfòmasyon ki nan dosye a parèt anlè paj sa a. Sous: KEP / CEP.
native_record.en: The registration details appear at the top of this page. Source: KEP / CEP.

correction.ht: Siyale yon erè oswa pwopoze yon sous
correction.en: Report an error or suggest a source

independent.ht: Yon pwojè endepandan pou edikasyon sivik

featured_title.ht: Ki moun ki vle reprezante w?

featured_text.ht: Chèche moun ki enskri pou prezidan, senatè, depite ak pòs lokal yo. Louvri pwofil yo pou eksplore sous enfòmasyon sou yo.
featured_text.en: Find registrations for president, senate, deputy and local offices. Open a profile to explore the sources about each person.

share.ht: Kopye lyen sa w ap gade a

copy_failed.ht: Ou ka kopye adrès paj la nan navigatè a.
copy_failed.en: You can copy the page address from your browser.

stale.ht: Done sa yo bezwen yon lòt revizyon. Gade dat ki endike anlè a.
stale.en: These records need another review. Check the snapshot date above.

web_available_hint.ht: Sijè ki an gri yo pa gen sous ki koresponn ak filtè ou chwazi yo.
web_available_hint.en: Grey topics have no sources matching the selected filters.

web_source_hint.ht: Chwazi yon sous pou wè apèsi li epi louvri lyen li.
web_source_hint.en: Choose a source to view its preview and open its link.

web_registry_only.ht: Pou kounye a, nou gen sèlman enskripsyon KEP moun sa a. Nou poko ajoute lòt sous revize sou li.
web_registry_only.en: For now, this web contains only this person’s CEP registration. Other reviewed sources have not yet been added.

source_account_note.ht: Nou te revize sèlman pati atik la ki vizib pou tout moun. Sit sous la mande yon kont pou li rès la.
source_account_note.en: We reviewed only the publicly visible excerpt. The source website requires an account to read the rest.

link_unavailable.ht: Sous ki nan lyen sa a pa disponib nan pwofil sa a. Chwazi youn nan sijè ki gen sous yo.
link_unavailable.en: The source in this saved link is not available on this profile. Choose a topic with sources.

index_note.ht: Sa a se yon lyen nan endèks achiv la, ak tit orijinal piblikatè a. Louvri sous la pou li atik la ak tout kontèks li.
index_note.en: This archive index entry shows the publisher’s original headline. Open the source for the full report and context.

relation_headline.ht: Non an nan tit sous orijinal la
relation_headline.en: Named in the original source headline

relation_mention.ht: Non an parèt nan sous la

mention_note.ht: Sous sa a site non moun nan, men li ka konsantre sou yon lòt sijè.
mention_note.en: This source mentions the person, but may focus on another subject.

archive_search.ht: Chèche nan achiv moun sa a

source_load_error.ht: Nou pa rive chaje lòt sous yo. Eseye ankò oswa louvri lis achiv la.
source_load_error.en: We could not load the remaining sources. Retry or open the archive list.

source_no_results.ht: Pa gen sous pou filtè sa yo. Chwazi yon lòt ane oswa efase filtè yo.
source_no_results.en: No sources match these filters. Choose another year or clear the filters.

archive_recent.ht: Dènye sous yo; tout achiv la disponib nan lyen ki anba a.
archive_recent.en: Recent sources; the full archive is available through the link below.

archive_back.ht: Retounen sou twal moun sa a

event_date.ht: Dat evènman an selon sous la
event_date.en: Event date stated by the source

video_archive_note.ht: Paj achiv la disponib. Nou poko konfime si videyo ki sou li a ka jwe.
video_archive_note.en: The archive page is available. Playback of its embedded video has not been confirmed.

video_metadata_note.ht: Sous la idantifye anrejistreman sa a. Prezans li nan achiv la pa vle di nou verifye tout deklarasyon ki nan li.
video_metadata_note.en: The source identifies this recording. Its inclusion does not mean every statement in it has been verified.

history_pending.ht: Rechèch istorik sou pwofil sa a poko fini.
history_pending.en: Historical research for this profile is not complete.

history_scope.ht: Achiv la ap grandi. Rechèch nan kèk piblikatè pa vle di nou jwenn tout sa ki te pibliye tout kote.
history_scope.en: This archive is growing. Searching selected publishers does not establish that everything published everywhere has been found.

relation_candidate_channel.ht: Sou chanèl kandida a bay lyen li a
relation_candidate_channel.en: On the channel linked by the candidate

relation_archive_context.ht: Nan yon koleksyon achiv sou moun nan
relation_archive_context.en: In an archive collection about the person
